title: User Created Enduro: race a course of your own gates from a link
summary: A User Created Enduro is a course of 3 to 50 gates on one of eight environments. It can be shared as a link, which opens the course straight into a race. This is the first slice of the Waypoint Editor.
details: A course has a name, 1 to 5 laps and its gates. Gate positions snap to a half-foot grid and headings to a fixed step, so every platform reads the same numbers.
The compact code is about 6 bytes per gate. A link with wp=CODE opens the course. Pause → Copy ride link copies it.
Codes are untrusted. The version, venue, laps, gate count, name and gate spacing are checked when decoded, and every gate must lie on the venue's terrain at load.
The race uses the long Enduro's scenery and rules with the course's gates. It races alone: no CPU riders, no profile points, no records, and not offered in online rooms.
limitation: Races alone. CPU riders follow the long Enduro route, not the new gates. Earns no points and keeps no records. Not offered in rooms.
verification: atv-core user_course tests (5) and atv-game launch tests (6) pass; make precheck passes. tools/test_engine_user_course.mjs was added (it runs with the editor PR); its link race and tampered-link refusal are covered there. Choices are recorded in research/RACING.md.
